results.title: Seoul rises to 7th in global financial hub ranking
results.description: Seoul ranked seventh among 139 cities in the latest Global Financial Centers Index, rising one notch from the previous report, the Seoul city government announced Wednesday. The capital has ranked among the world’s top 10 for the fourth consecutive year. Published jointly by London-based consultancy Z/Yen Group and the China Development Institute, the Global Financial Centers Index compares the competitiveness of major financial hubs worldwide.
